answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: every reward an identity earns flows into a locked river that releases only 1/30 per epoch, and any slashed attestation claws back the unvested balance. A farmer spinning up 500 fake agents must keep each one honest for a full month before cashing out, so a quick zephyr of spam earns nothing liquid, while the first audit that catches the ring turns the tide and burns every pending reward across the cluster.
